objective: Extract durable bash/Python validation knowledge into typed Go/ao surfaces without blanket-rewriting shell scripts.

density.intent: Use the existing ao gate boundary as a strangler seam: port tiny deterministic predicates first, preserve shell wrappers, then extract shared Go primitives before moving registry/SKU generation.

boundary.bounded_context: BC2 Validation / BC4 Factory / BC5 CLI runtime
non_goals: Do not start with scripts/generate-registry.sh or SKU drift.
Do not remove shell wrappers while CI and local entrypoints call them.
Do not make GitHub Actions the release authority.
write_scope_first_slice: cli/internal/gates/workflow_coverage.go only if native-wrapper metadata is needed
tests/scripts/check-quarantine-empty.bats if wrapper behavior needs a script-level fixture

evidence: scripts/check-quarantine-empty.sh is a 40-line deterministic policy with ALLOW_QUARANTINE override and shell/bats enumeration.
cli/internal/gates/checks/seed.go registers always.quarantine-empty as Fast|Full, blocking, shell-backed.
cli/internal/gates/registry.go requires exactly one of Backing or Run.
cli/internal/gates/workflow_coverage.go derives workflow script coverage from Backing scripts.
.github/workflows/validate.yml still directly invokes scripts/check-quarantine-empty.sh and scripts/validate-embedded-sync.sh.
scripts/generate-registry.sh and SKU generation are broad cross-surface generators and should not be first.
density.decision: Default next move is native-port always.quarantine-empty with script-wrapper parity. It proves the extraction pattern with the smallest blast radius.
constraint: Keep local cockpit gate / ao gate check as release authority.
Keep shell wrappers callable until downstream surfaces migrate.
Preserve gate ID, tiers, blocking status, and always-run routing.
Run test-first and compare wrapper/native behavior before claiming done.

issues.title: Native-port quarantine-empty gate with wrapper parity
Native-port embedded-sync after wrapper parity pattern lands
Extract shared Go primitives for file/git/doc validation
Move registry/SKU generation behind typed Go/ao engine

done_when: Native always.quarantine-empty check has test coverage for pass, fail, ignored files, missing directory, and ALLOW_QUARANTINE override.
Gate registry preserves ID, tiers, blocking status, and always-run selection.
Script wrapper remains callable and behavior-compatible.
Workflow parity handles native check plus legacy wrapper without false drift.
likely_blocker: The gate model currently allows exactly one of Backing or Run, while workflow coverage discovers scripts through Backing only. The implementation may need explicit legacy-wrapper metadata or a targeted workflow coverage adjustment.
ignore_today: release/tag/GitHub Actions telemetry unless the local gate contradicts it
